# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 14 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 14:3 — worship me — the command to angels

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "worship me in the sight of God" | Literal adorare me coram Deo |
| LOGOS | "worship me in the sight of God" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "worship me in God's sight" | Minor variation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree. Adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA is equally acceptable.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
